title: The Row of Ancestors
prompt: Five ancestors hang in a row. Frames are numbered 1 to 5 from the left. Use the facts below. Then answer: which ancestor hangs in the frame the candle's smoke pointed to? (Check your clue notes.)
clues: The Baron hangs at one end of the row.
The Baron hangs further left than the Widow.
The Doctor hangs somewhere to the left of the Widow.
The Maid hangs directly next to the Doctor and directly next to the Butler.
The Butler hangs somewhere to the right of the Doctor.
The Widow does not hang next to the Maid.

wrong_feedback.butler: That portrait is close by. Recount the frames from the left.
wrong_feedback.doctor: That portrait is close by. Recount the frames from the left.

reveal_text: Behind the frame someone scratched a row of numbers into the plaster: 3, 4, 6, 10, 18 ... and then a blank. The vent's dial wants the next one.
